unresolved_components.concise_supported_event: Acting Deputy Attorney General Emil Bove ordered personnel actions and a review of FBI employees who had worked on January 6 cases on January 31, 2025. unresolved_components.concise_supported_event: On August 7, 2025, the FBI dismissed at least three senior officials, including former acting director Brian Driscoll, during a broader reshuffling under FBI Director Kash Patel.  The officials had connections to January 6 or other politically sensitive investigations, according to The Washington Post.  This was a later personnel episode than the January 2025 Justice Department review and should be described on its own date.
